features.feature: Sequential stages and direct executable steps
Persistent build history and stage/step state
Retry completed builds with preserved parameters
features.notes: A retry creates a new build and reuses persisted non-secret parameters; secret parameters require explicit replacement values, while richer retry policies and attempt grouping remain planned.

features.feature: FIFO queue with global and per-project limits
features.notes: Queued cancellation is handled before execution; priority, resource requirements, and observable queue administration remain planned.

features.feature: Build artifact collection, checksums, and download
features.notes: Local workspace artifacts are copied into build-scoped storage and exposed through the API; retention policies and remote object stores remain planned.
Validated locally on Unix; remote agents and container execution are planned.

Exact relative cache paths are validated, entries are isolated by project and key, restored before execution, and saved atomically after success; fallback keys, eviction, and remote backends remain planned.
Explicit local fetch, detached revision checkout, and clean preparation are supported at build admission; provider credentials and provider-specific webhook adapters remain planned.

features.feature: Manual/API builds and persistent UTC cron schedules
features.notes: Five-field cron expressions are validated, persisted, atomically claimed, dispatched into real builds, and exposed through API, CLI, and desktop controls; provider repository-event and upstream trigger mapping remain planned.

The generic endpoint verifies HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body, atomically deduplicates event IDs, and queues one real build; provider-specific payload adapters and repository-event mapping remain planned.

Agents can negotiate protocol version, advertise capabilities, reconnect with session fencing, and appear online or stale through the server registry; remote assignment, execution, transfer, and lost-job handling remain planned.

Optional in-memory Bearer-token protection, mandatory authentication for non-loopback binds, exact CORS origins, request limits, and baseline security headers are supported; user identity, roles, and project permissions remain planned.

features.feature: Secret parameter redaction and log masking
features.notes: Secret parameters require runtime input without defaults, are redacted in persisted build/API data, masked in emitted process output, and must be supplied again for retries; encrypted storage, credential ownership, and access control remain planned.
Rivet will define a versioned extension protocol instead of reproducing the Java plugin ABI.
